title: Analysis of the risk profile of tumor patients
summary:
Tumor diseases occur sporadically in most individuals and may be associated with external influences or pre-existing conditions. However, some individuals develop tumors as part of an inherited tumor predisposition syndrome (TPS). Many TPS exhibit incomplete penetrance, meaning not all individuals with a tumor predisposition necessarily develop a TPS-associated tumor. Therefore, it is suspected that besides the TPS, additional genetic and/or non-genetic factors play a role in tumor development.

The TumorRisk project aims to analyze participants regarding TPS and exposures. This involves conducting surveys of study participants. A central part of the study is the analysis of family pedigrees, supplemented by tumor-associated exposures.

The goal of the TumorRisk study is to establish a risk profile of individuals with TPS compared to those with sporadic tumors. To this end, the TumorRisk Register is being established to systematically document and investigate exposures and predispositions related to tumor development.
conditions: Neoplasms of uncertain or unknown behaviour

interventions.name: Study participants with a tumor predisposition. Standardized assessment of the predisposition-exposition profile using a survey (baseline assessment). Follow-up assessments conducted periodically thereafter (approximately annually).

Study participants without a (detectable) tumor predisposition. Standardized assessment of the predisposition-exposition profile using a survey (baseline assessment). Follow-up assessments conducted periodically thereafter (approximately annually).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of a tumor, regardless of stage
- Inpatient or outpatient consultation at the University Hospital Augsburg or one of the affiliated hospitals
- Written consent of the patient for study participation
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients under 18 years of age
- Patients unable to consent
- Patients with insufficient proficiency in German
- Patient unable to participate in the survey for other reasons
